policies.sourceText: Students must earn a grade of C or better in all courses toward the minor.

notes.text: Students should declare the Television Writing Minor no later than the middle of their sophomore year, at which time they should consult with the directors of their major and minor to plan their course of study.

The minor in TV Writing is offered in conjunction with the minor in Filmmaking through the undergraduate Creative Writing and Film Program. Minors graduate with a SPEC SCRIPT and a REVISED PILOT SCRIPT.

Program contacts: Undergraduate Program Director Karen Offitzer (karen.offitzer@stonybrook.edu); Program Coordinator Chryso Tsoumpelis (chrysovalantou.tsoumpelis@stonybrook.edu); Office: Melville Library, 3rd floor, N3017.
